item.title: How to use Storybook in React
item.description:
Building complex user interfaces requires a strategy that prioritizes isolation and predictability.
As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built thousands of components that rely on robust documentation and visual testing. The most efficient and modern solution for managing component lifecycles in React is to implement Storybook, which enables Component-Driven Development (CDD).
By using Storybook, you can develop components without worrying about application-specific logic, APIs, or data structures.
